The only changes are character appearances, applied per position: the CENTER position becomes <Subject 1> following <Picture 1>; the LEFT-1 position becomes <Subject 2> following <Picture 2>, both clearly rendered in anime style; the RIGHT-1 female character remains <Subject 3>. All dialogue and original voices come from <Audio 1>, preserved unchanged, and are lip-synced precisely by the corresponding characters.
[Shot 1] A static wide medium shot of the luxury banquet hall from <Video 1>, with background extras. <Subject 2>, the anime xianxia woman with the black high bun, jade hairpins and flowing pale cyan and moon-white hanfu, stands at the left; <Subject 1>, the anime wuxia warrior with the black high bun and black cross-collar hanfu, stands at the center, the tallest figure, looking forward; <Subject 3>, the woman in the white lace gown from <Video 1>, stands quietly on the right holding an object. <Subject 2> turns toward <Subject 1> and gestures with her hand.
